name: Linear Algebra II
description:
Review of vector space, linear transformations, dual and double dual of a vector space and transpose of a linear transformation. 
Eigenvalue and eigenvector of an operator, characteristic and minimal polynomials.
Diagonalizability of linear operators, triangulation, simultaneous triangulation and simultaneous diagonalization.
The primary decomposition theorem, cyclic decomposition theorem and the rational and Jordan canonical forms, computation of invariant factors.
Inner product spaces, adjoint of an operator, Hermitian, unitary and normal operators, Spectral theorem for normal operators, polar decomposition, Spectral decomposition, singular value decomposition and its applications.
Bilinear and quadratic forms, Symmetric and Skew-symmetric bilinear forms, positive definite matrices.
Non-negative matrices, Perron-Frobenius theory and applications, generalized inverse of a matrix.
